import base64
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path('/home/joshua/lonely-runner-formalization')
manifest_path = Path('/tmp/astra-pass69-inputs.json')
manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
checks = []
for name, digest in manifest['hashes'].items():
    data = (root / name).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == digest, name
    assert data.endswith(b'\n'), name
    assert all(line.rstrip() == line for line in data.splitlines()), name
checks.append({'kind': 'frozen_file_bindings_and_whitespace', 'count': len(manifest['hashes']), 'result': 'passed'})
for review, sources in manifest['review_bindings'].items():
    text = (root / review).read_text()
    for source in sources:
        assert manifest['hashes'][source] in text, (review, source)
checks.append({'kind': 'review_source_bindings', 'result': 'passed'})
control = json.loads((root / 'research/astra-general-slow-row-control.json').read_text())
attempt, = control['execution']['attempts']
source = base64.b64decode(attempt['program_source_base64'])
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest() == attempt['program_source_sha256']
assert len(source) == attempt['program_source_bytes']
assert attempt['exit_code'] == 0 and attempt['stderr_complete_bounded'] == ''
output = json.loads(attempt['stdout_complete_bounded'])
assert output['triples_examined'] == output['candidate_triples_total'] == 4060
assert output['open_cell_count'] == 30 and output['cut_count'] == 31
assert output['counterexample_found'] is False
checks.append({'kind': 'worker_receipt_integrity_without_mathematical_replay', 'result': 'passed', 'program_sha256': attempt['program_source_sha256'], 'found_witness_modular_branch_executed': False})
commands = []
for argv in ([sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/validate_workflow.py'], ['git', 'diff', '--check'], [sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/manage_storage.py']):
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True)
    commands.append({'argv': argv, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
    assert result.returncode == 0, commands[-1]
receipt = {
    'checkpoint': 'Pass69',
    'parent_main': '4227fef76e8a2081460c27b3af627bc6dcb501d4',
    'status': 'verified_local_pending_publication',
    'hashes': manifest['hashes'],
    'review_bindings': manifest['review_bindings'],
    'checks': checks,
    'commands': commands,
    'root_verifier': {'argv': [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__))], 'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'input_source': manifest_path.read_text(), 'input_sha256': hashlib.sha256(manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},
    'mathematical_verification': 'Independent hand reviews and root source reads; accepted hash-bound one-run Fraction receipt. No unchanged mathematical replay, no Lean work.',
    'scope': 'General-slow audit, strict ideal failure transfer, and one bounded ideal-row nonfinding. Neither general candidate existence nor unrestricted LRC resolved.',
    'excluded': 'Ongoing uniform ideal-row-selection audit and any draft it creates.',
    'failure_history': 'One root task-metrics schema error before worker launch, retained in workflow-state orchestration_observations; no executable repair or verification-driver failure.',
}
(root / 'research/astra-pass69-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'checkpoint': 'Pass69', 'result': 'passed', 'frozen_files': len(manifest['hashes']), 'commands': commands}, indent=2))
